adaptations: Native namespace RHLean.Analysis.AlpogeThin.NativeRay; no upstream imports or terminal theorem.
Complete RayData logical fields retained; optional tactic-generated nonzero proofs in cls_mul made explicit.
Source finite quotient proof factored into the actual class/residue injection, reused for finiteness and the new quantitative bound #G <= classNumber(K)*M^[K:Q].
Literal same-modulus primeTo/rayCon, quotient classes, nonzero and congruent-to-one multipliers retained, including M=1.
Real aRay is the ncard of actual nonzero prime-to-M ideal norm fibers; lamRay is the finsum of actual ideal prime-power logarithms.
Exact ideal divisor/product bijection proves source aRay_mul_log, including g/h orientation and every positive prime power.
Deprecated finite_setOf_absNorm aliases and dif_pos/dif_neg replaced by pinned current names; truly unused NumberField section instances omitted.
Proposition-valued finite ray-group instance expressed as an attributed theorem; no budgets, disabled linters, local Lean execution, axioms or placeholders.
proven_construction_scope: Canonical full finite RayData for every number field K and nonzero modulus M.
Actual injection into ClassGroup(O_K) times O_K/(M), all quotient classes invertible, canonical principal congruence and quotient universal equivalence.
Exact bound #RayGroup <= classNumber(K)*M^[K:Q], degree-two specialization and equality with classNumber at M=1.
Actual finite ideal counts, nonnegative prime-power weights, zero/one coefficient normalization and exact logarithmic convolution.
